summary: VEON Ltd. filed a Form 6-K (foreign private issuer current report) furnishing a November 6, 2026 press release announcing that subsidiary Beeline Kazakhstan completed its acquisition of 100% of OLX Group LLP (OLX KZ) from OLX Global B.V. for total consideration of USD 81 million, inclusive of roughly USD 6 million of completion adjustments, after receiving requisite regulatory approvals; the deal was first agreed in October 2025. OLX KZ reports about 9 million monthly active users and just over USD 28 million annual revenue for the year ending March 2026. No advisor or board recommendation was disclosed; OLX Group provides transitional IT services under a handover arrangement. Watch integration execution, digital-revenue contribution, and any residual earn-out or adjustment true-ups.
